title: SettingsClient.onChange / ipfsDesktop.agentSettings.onChange
description: Event payload delivered to a SettingsClient.onChange() subscriber (agent-settings-contract task 1.5). On HTTP the client subscribes to the settings change stream (SSE, mcp-agent-settings-api 1.5); on the Desktop bridge the main process pushes ipfsDesktop.agentSettings.onChange to the trusted frame (desktop-agent-settings-bridge 1.2: push events replace the read-once at window creation, so a second tab and Desktop reflect changes, assessment-ui 5.2). The event carries only the new revision; subscribers re-read through get() to fetch the new state. It never carries settings values or key material. The payload mirrors the server change event (../settings-event.schema.json) exactly.

type.description: Event discriminator. The only event kind on this channel.

revision.description: The new settings revision, equal to what a subsequent get() returns.
